component.name: Ask the Model
component.summary: Local AI chat with repository-grounded scientific sources

description.p: Ask the Model is a local-first GTK desktop interface for locally managed language models through an Ollama-compatible provider. It discovers completion-capable provider models, streams responses and keeps independent in-memory conversation state in multiple chat tabs.

Version 0.3.0 adds repository-grounded exploration for the fixed Empirical World3 Dynamics, Cognitive Belief Dynamics and Romanian Monetary Dynamics repository suite. AtM can refresh and download exact Git revisions, validate immutable local snapshots, build deterministic local retrieval indexes and expose compact citations with exact repository, version, SHA, locator and immutable-source provenance.

AtM remains an interface and retrieval layer. The external provider owns inference, AI model files remain separate artifacts, and the scientific repositories remain authoritative for their own model definitions, data, assumptions, provenance and validation.
Repository-Grounded Multi-Chat with validated immutable EWD/CBD/RMD snapshots, deterministic local retrieval, per-chat identity pinning, compact citations and exact-SHA source provenance.
Documentation and public-metadata consistency update with expanded first-time setup guidance, model-management documentation and corrected application metadata.
Installation and release-distribution correction with a directly downloadable Flatpak release asset and clarified dependency guidance.
Local Chat Baseline with local Ollama discovery, completion-capable AI-model selection, refresh progress, streamed chat and in-session history.
